name: shader-background
title: Shader Background
description: Small nk atmosphere catalog (mist, haze, current, signal, …) with scrim and pause. Inspired by beUI; engines from Paper Shaders — not a port of beUI’s effect list.
docs: Pin @paper-design/shaders-react (0.0.x may break between minors). Parent needs a definite size. Use effect (default mist), optional scrim/paused. Auto-pauses off-screen, hidden tab, and prefers-reduced-motion.
